stem: The data of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, runs to August 2026. Month 3 retention was 78% for the January 2026 cohort, 80% for February, 84% for March and 85% for April. Month 6 retention was 70% for January and 72% for February; March and April have not reached month 6. Which statement do these numbers support?

options.text: Newer cohorts keep more of their businesses at month 3
March and April will keep more of their businesses at month 6
Retention falls with each newer cohort, so the newer ones are worse
The April cohort is the largest, so its retention counts the most
